source: Recovered Carista native diagnostic/debug functions and retained in-car logs.

transport_findings.carista_behavior: establishEcuComm uses 2 outer attempts, 4 TP2.0 open sends, and 4 channel-parameter sends before giving up.
transport_findings.implementation_note: Keep reopening the TP2.0 channel when channel parameters are not acknowledged; do not reuse a half-open channel.
log_evidence: Early no-response logs often show defaulted channel parameters T1/T2/T3/T4=FF.
Later positive logs show A10F8AFF4FFF with T1=0x8A and T3=0x4F after channel-parameter setup.

transport_findings.carista_behavior: readResponses calls receiveMore up to 2 times; receiveMore sends A3 with timeout/spec 0x200.
transport_findings.implementation_note: When a frame sequence starts but no final frame arrives, send the computed ACK and then A3 receive-more before treating the read as empty.
log_evidence: Several retained sessions have transmit ACK B1 but no immediate final payload.
Carista's receive-more path explains why a one-shot ELM read can miss later frames.

transport_findings.carista_behavior: readResponses tolerates negative responses up to 30, drops old sequence numbers unless the 7F xx 78 response-pending hack is active, and sends NACK for unexpected next sequence.
transport_findings.implementation_note: Preserve Carista sequence-state rules in future module-aware UDS scanners instead of parsing line-by-line ELM output as independent responses.
log_evidence: UDS scans captured 7F1978 followed by buffered positive DTC frames.
Raw continuation payloads like 001C1C50AAAAAA appear when a simpler scanner treats stale continuation data as a standalone result.

transport_findings.carista_behavior: A8 is the TP2.0 disconnect path; readResponses clears receivedPackets before ACK_WAIT/NACK or disconnect paths.
transport_findings.implementation_note: Close with A8 when possible, then reopen cleanly. If A8 gets NO DATA, reset the adapter before the next channel-open attempt.
log_evidence: Successful one-shot sessions end with A8 and reset adapter formatting to ATCAF1/ATV0.
Logs that required a restart recovered after a fresh ATZ plus channel reopen.
